business_summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PYPL) is a digital-payments company. Its one sourced role on this chain is funding-and-settlement-rails: it is an integrated deposit and withdrawal rail on Kalshi, DraftKings Predictions and FanDuel Predicts, with Kalshi charging a 2% fee on PayPal deposits that the other two venues do not.
